definitions.explanation: A person who acts foolishly or comically to entertain others. Can refer to a professional entertainer or someone behaving in a clownish manner.
The act of behaving comically or playing the fool for amusement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道化|どうけ}だ。

examples.english: The jester performed in front of the king.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{道化|どうけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じていた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧になった。
examples.english: He always played the clown, but suddenly his expression turned serious.

examples.japanese: {道化|どうけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道化|どうけ}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。

⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげよう→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{道化|どうけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{笑|わら}わなかった→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: I played the fool to lighten the mood, but no one laughed.

notes:
USAGE:
{道化|どうけ} can refer either to a person (clown, jester) or to the act of clowning. The compound ⟦{道化師|どうけし}→道化師：15368_doukeshi⟧ specifically means a professional clown or jester.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道化|どうけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧ (to play the fool)
- ⟦{道化師|どうけし}→道化師：15368_doukeshi⟧ (clown; jester)
- {道化|どうけ}⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧ (farce; clownish act)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese performing arts, comic roles have a long history. {道化|どうけ} is sometimes used to describe the comedic servant characters in ⟦{狂言|きょうげん}→狂言：04456_kyougen⟧ plays.
